name: app/plan-summary
title: PlanSummary
summary: The plan an account is on: its name, its price per interval, its status in words and a status pill, the date it renews or ends, what it includes, and its actions. Provider-neutral: no provider, no payment method, no default currency or locale.

props.name: locale
props.description: A BCP 47 locale for the price and the date. Required: there is no default.

props.name: price
props.description: The price as Money: integer minor units and an ISO 4217 code. No default currency; without it no price is shown.

props.name: interval
props.description: How often it is charged ("per month"); without it the price stands alone.

props.name: periodEnd
props.description: The date it renews or ends, as an ISO date ("2026-11-24"), shown in `locale` in a <time datetime>.

props.name: action
props.description: The main action, a primary link ("Change plan", "Choose a plan", "Update payment").

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: A second action, an outline link ("Cancel plan"; pair it with ConfirmAction).

props.name: copy
props.type: { status?: Partial<Record<PlanStatus, string>>; per?: Partial<Record<PlanInterval, string>>; date?: Partial<Record<PlanStatus, string>>; features?: string; none?: string }
props.description: Words, for another language: the status pill, "per month", the words before the date, the features list's name, and the no-plan sentence.

props.name: id
props.description: The id the heading (`<id>-title`) is built from.

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes on the root, merged last.

behaviour: A <section> labelled by its heading, the plan's name.
The price is Money (`app/money`) formatted for `locale`, followed by the interval in words ("per month"). With no `price`, no price is shown; there is no default currency.
The status is written in a status pill: Active (success), Payment due (warning), Cancelled, Expired and No plan (neutral). The word, not the colour, carries it.
With `periodEnd`, a line says "Renews on", "Payment was due on", "Ends on" or "Ended on" by status, then the date in `locale` in a <time datetime>.
`status: "none"` shows the pill and a sentence that there is no plan, with no price, date or features, and keeps the actions ("Choose a plan").
It names no payment provider and no payment method, takes data and computes nothing about billing.

default.description: An active monthly plan in US dollars.

cancelled.description: Cancelled, yearly, in Zimbabwe Gold, h3.

localised.description: Every word replaced, in French for Senegal.

aria: The status is a word in the pill, never colour alone; the check glyphs are aria-hidden.

theming.brandOverlay: The main action is the shell's primary (`--app-accent`, else `--primary`). Status pills are fixed status colours, the same in every brand.

responsive: The status pill wraps under the name and price on a narrow column; actions wrap.
contract:
contract
  slot is "plan-summary"
  uses money
  uses status
  when default shows h2 "Business"
  when default shows span "Active"
  when default shows a "Change plan"
  when none shows a "Choose a plan"
  when cancelled shows h3 "Business"
end

checks.say: A section labelled by the plan's name.
The price is Money, exact, in the caller's currency.
Active is a success pill with the word.
The renewal date is a <time> in the locale.
An active plan says it renews.
The actions are a primary link and an outline link.
Payment due is a warning pill with the word.
A past-due date says payment was due.
No plan: no price, no date, no features.
No plan says so in words.
A currency with no minor unit (CFA franc) is exact.
The date words can be replaced.
